title: Mystery of Firefly Light

scenes.text: Why does the firefly flash about once per second?

scenes.label: LUCIFERIN REACTS WITH OXYGEN
scenes.text: They produce light using luciferin that reacts with oxygen, a cold chemical reaction.

scenes.label: MATE SIGNALING FLASH PATTERN
scenes.text: Each species has a unique flash pattern to attract mates across the night.

scenes.label: SYNCHRONIZED FLASHING DETER PREDATORS
scenes.text: Large groups synchronize their lights, creating a confusing display that deters predators.
